## Constraints

### Must

- Read docs/DESIGN.md as the normative TARGET before selecting inspiration; current CSS is not proof the target is implemented.
- Use Lora for editorial serif and Plus Jakarta Sans for sans-serif UI.
- Use white surfaces, small radii, thin overlay shadows, mobile-first field flows and readable controls.
- Keep Ringkasan distinct from Kegiatan, stable sidebar, workspace logo/profile navbar, public site navigation and new-event-only wizard.
- Retain simulation, expiry, sources, permissions and truthful loading/error states.
- Use existing React/Tailwind components and pnpm; inspect catalog before considering code retrieval.

### Avoid

- Cream, pastel surfaces, large radii, heavy shadows, decorative spark icons and badge-text-badge rows.
- Automatic shadcn installs, unrelated dependencies, paid AI generation or code retrieval without a concrete need.
- Sending private project data, credentials or user documents to design services.

## Decisions

- **rangkai-design-target**: Preserve the product identity and simplify the existing UI using docs/DESIGN.md. Catalog results are inspiration, not permission to copy a whole dashboard or add KPI decoration. (docs/DESIGN.md; user discussion 2026-11-12)
- **rangkai-assistant-scope**: Global bottom-left read-only assistant. Private data strictly scoped to current session, organization membership and event permissions. No decorative spark icons. See canonical design for requirements; this is target, not implemented. (docs/DESIGN.md; user decision 2026-11-12)
